title: UI kit: 60 icons, 11 mode covers, 22 small items
owner_gate: icon set approved as one family (one nav-bar set), palette from tokens.json

budget.hard_stop_rule: nominal + 15%: above that the run stops and the owner is asked
assumptions: 60 icons: 5 nav + 6 currencies + 8 actions + 10 status + 12 system + 6 audio + 11 modes + 2 misc

candidates_policy: icons: 4 candidates at 1k medium (1 cr); covers: 4 at 2k high (2 cr); small items: 2 at 1k (1 cr)

selection.gate: set consistency: same stroke weight, same lacquer/gold language, tokens.json palette
criteria: zero text, letters, numerals or glyph-like marks (OCR gate = 0 characters)
reads at 48 px: one strong silhouette
same stroke weight and corner language as the rest of the kit
colors inside the tokens.json palette: lacquer / paper / gold / jade
gold only for SSR and one accent

pilot.go_rule: owner looks at the pilot frames; any red-line or drift failure -> fix the prompt before the full run

tool_note: gpt_image_2_6 without elements. Backgrounds of covers could be re-rendered with LoRA v2 later; this plan uses gpt for all three groups.
guards: Before each launch: estimate_*_cost -> quote_ref; abort the task when the quote is above max_credits.
Actual spend goes to design/art_batches/SPEND_LOG.csv; more than 15% over the batch nominal = stop and ask the owner.
Every output lands in assets/incoming, then double anatomy audit -> metadata scrub -> watermark pass -> manifest `approve`.
Prompts are untested: run the pilot tasks first (2-3 frames), look at them, only then release the rest.
